unsupportedReason: Unsupported on the frozen local Stack: key.read-only and key.revoked require positive and negative probes using the same actually issued secret before and after revocation. A final admin key listing cannot reconstruct that history. KeyPermissionProbe requires a retained issued-key consumer and distinct same-attempt observer. secrets.absent requires a complete independently scanned raw artifact inventory; observe must not read the model transcript. Bootstrap retirement and worker replacement evidence are also unavailable. No key or scan success may be inferred from final state.

provenance.derivation: Town oracle fixtures contain no native governance, credential custody, issued-key history or clarification event identities. Null marks an unavailable expectation and must fail oracle.verify; it is never a passing baseline.
